_README: Hand-written, evidence-backed symbol names for the Pokemon Stadium 2 (G&S,
US) decomp. Every entry must be justified by reverse engineering recorded in
docs/NAMING.md or RENTAL_REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md. Nothing here is a guess: if
we could not establish what something does, it is deliberately absent.
This file is hand-maintained and takes precedence over tools/s1_transfer.json,
which is machine-generated by tools/xmatch_stadium1.py and must not be edited
by hand. To override a transferred name, add the same key here.
'permutations' are simultaneous swaps -- the existing names are WRONG and
rotated, so they must be replaced in a single pass and only once.
Functions Stadium 2 already names, where the Stadium 1 decomp matched them
to a differently-named function. Recorded rather than resolved: the
upstream pret/pokestadiumgs name stands unless someone re-derives it.
These are notes, not renames -- apply_names.py ignores this section.
_conflicts_with_stadium_1.Thread3_CreateThread: matches Stadium 1 Sched_Init (normalised). Both are right about the body; S1's name describes what the thread does, upstream's describes how it is made. Upstream name kept.
_conflicts_with_stadium_1.Thread4_CreateThread: matches Stadium 1 Audio_StartThread (normalised). Same situation: if S1 is right that thread 4 is the audio thread, this is worth renaming once corroborated from the thread's entry point.
_conflicts_with_stadium_1.Vi_SelectMode: matches Stadium 1 Video_SetMode (callgraph). Same function, two spellings of the same idea. Upstream name kept.
